kind: primary-owned additive evidence refinement and repair authorization

compatibility.scope: test-only native evidence, validators, and the already authorized bounded Lean projection

field_map.native_owner: Receiving::callback_route_for_request; the actual ViewKind::CallbackResult(CallbackUseHandle) read from the observed execution view
field_map.type: CallbackUseHandle identity encoded as its owning callback_uses index
field_map.validation: Pass the actual CallbackUseHandle to callback_grant and validators. Keep CallbackEntryHandle distinct; never cast or reuse its ordinal as a use identity.

field_map.native_owner: Machine::propagate_request, from the selected live Frame::CatchReturn HandlerInstallation
field_map.validation: Retain the actual installation.occurrence separately from the Catch source-site occurrence; require validate_handler_installation success, installation.occurrence < Machine.next_handler, installation.owner = current_execution_owner, and owner active. The Lean InstalledCatch handle denotes this dynamic occurrence; preserve source site separately.

field_map.json_path: local_grant.observation.observer, observer_bound, event_id, execution_occurrence, view_id, receipt_id, execution_table
field_map.native_owner: Receiving::observe and the exact Observation consumed by local_grant; Receiving.executions and Receiving.next_observer
field_map.type: usize observer and bound; event identity; execution occurrence; view/receipt identities; ordered list of (view, receipt) table rows
joins: local_grant query uses this same observation
field_map.validation: Carry a constructor-owned bound on each Observation, set by observe after assigning its observer. Validate evidence against the actual Observation supplied to the request and the owning execution table; do not synthesize a table row or infer the observed occurrence using first-match position. Emit the ordered table projection from Receiving.executions.

repair_packet.resume_requires: This frozen map and R1 archive committed and pushed first
findings_to_close_together: wrong CallbackEntryHandle passed where CallbackUseHandle is required
repair_packet.after_repair: Freeze exact source hashes and updated handoff; STOP for fresh independent exact-hash pre-compile review. Compilation and runtime each require a separate primary authorization after the preceding gate.
